title: Lipid bilayer MD analysis toolkit
description: Analysis code for all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of mixed lipid bilayers: area compressibility modulus (KA) from box-area fluctuations, area per lipid, acyl-chain order parameters, lipid–lipid and ion–lipid interaction energies, Voronoi analysis, lateral distribution, RDFs, lipid spacing, water penetration, tail splay and lateral diffusion, together with the figure scripts for the associated publications.
